title: Domain scout strategy for rare/specialty LLMs and procurement criteria
creator: Priya Narang
description: Run a rapid program to identify, evaluate, and prioritize niche/specialty LLMs that serve narrow regulated verticals (e.g., clinical trial annotation, actuarial language, maritime safety logs). Deliver a procurement-ready rubric that the GTM and legal teams can use to trigger Dedicated purchases or private deployments when model supply risk or capability gaps are material.
acceptance_criteria: Documented list of 12 candidate niche models with provenance and compatibility notes (quantization, licensing, hardware affinity)
A 6-criterion procurement rubric (accuracy on vertical probes, latency tail, quantization compatibility, supportability, licensing risk, fallback cost) with threshold cutoffs and recommended actions
Benchmark workbook with synthetic workloads for each vertical (latency P50/P95, token-cost projection for 100M monthly tokens)
Runbook describing procurement trigger thresholds and escalation path for Dedicated capacity commitments
Stakeholder signoff from Legal (licensing), Security (data flows), and Solutions (GTM risk)
context_notes: Motivation: field teams report intermittent gaps for highly specialized use-cases where mainstream open models underperform. Buying dedicated variants or enabling private deployments for these pockets can unlock customer retention but requires a lean decision framework. This ticket focuses on surfacing candidate models and practical procurement triggers rather than long-term partnerships.
updates: 2026-03-10: Scoped program; aligned with Solutions and Legal on candidate vertical list (clinical-annotation, insurance-actuarial, legal-claims, maritime-log parsing).
2026-03-11: Ran initial compatibility sweep (license & quantization) for 28 upstream models; 12 moved to candidate set. Notes added to the model compatibility sheet.

2026-03-12: Experiment plan drafted for synthetic workloads and latency-cost projection. Created Google Drive folder and seed notebooks. Requested Security input on data handling for private evals (confluence: security-eval-guidance link added).
Next: schedule stakeholder workshop (Solutions + Legal + Infra) and allocate ENG pairing for one vertical POC.
